subject: Web Technologies
text: Which HTML element creates a hyperlink to another resource?
explanation: The anchor element creates a hyperlink, with its destination commonly supplied by the href attribute.

subject: Web Technologies
text: Which HTML element is commonly used to attach an external CSS stylesheet?
explanation: A link element with rel="stylesheet" and an href to the CSS file connects an external stylesheet.

subject: Web Technologies
text: Which condition is required for an XML document to be well-formed?
optionB: Every opening tag must have a matching closing tag or be self-closing
explanation: XML is case-sensitive and requires properly nested elements with matching end tags, or self-closing empty elements.

subject: Web Technologies
text: What does the JavaScript strict equality operator === compare?
optionA: Only the string representation of values
optionC: Value and type without coercing unlike types
explanation: Strict equality does not coerce operands to a common type before comparison.

subject: Web Technologies
text: What is a common purpose of AJAX in a web application?
optionA: To update part of a page using asynchronous requests without a full-page reload
optionC: To compile JavaScript into Java bytecode
optionD: To assign IP addresses to clients
explanation: AJAX allows a browser to exchange data asynchronously and update page content without navigating to a new full page.

subject: Web Technologies
text: Which jQuery selector targets the element whose id is status?
explanation: The # prefix selects an element by its id in jQuery, so #status targets id="status".

subject: Web Technologies
text: Which statement best describes the HTTP GET method?
optionA: It is intended to retrieve a representation and should not change server state
optionB: It must delete the requested resource
optionD: It is used only for file uploads
explanation: GET is a safe HTTP method intended for retrieving a representation; applications should not use it for state-changing actions.

subject: Web Technologies
text: Which PHP superglobal contains data submitted in the body of an HTTP POST request using standard form encoding?
explanation: PHP populates $_POST with form fields submitted using application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data.
